metadata.name: redundant_commonality_controls_v1
metadata.description: Control dataset of common collocational refinements. Each chain has a base concept plus four refinement levels where added modifiers are common, expected, or weakly informative rather than strongly independent semantic constraints.
metadata.purpose: Test whether LLMs compress commonality or weak semantic additions, as opposed to truly independent refinements.
design_rules: Each chain uses very common words that naturally go together.
Each refinement is intentionally weak, expected, prototypical, or partially redundant.
These are controls for commonality and low-information additions, not strong confirmatory refinement chains.
Base plus four refinement levels are included for every chain.
